title: A new colorimetric method for determining antioxidant levels using 3,5-dibromo-4-nitrosobenzene sulfonate (DBNBS)
author: Hamasaki, Kashiwagi, et al.

steps.title: Extract antioxidants from beverage samples
steps.instruction: Process 50 ml of each beverage by freeze‑drying, dissolve the residue in 50 ml methanol, vortex for 5 min, centrifuge at 10 000 ×g for 5 min, collect the supernatant and store it at 4 °C under a nitrogen atmosphere.

substeps.instruction: Freeze‑dry 50 ml of sample.
Dissolve the dried residue in 50 ml methanol (same volume).
Vortex the mixture for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 10 000 ×g for 5 minutes.
Collect the supernatant.
Store the supernatant at 4 °C in a nitrogen atmosphere.

steps.title: Assay samples with DBNBS method
steps.instruction: Perform the DBNBS colorimetric assay on each extracted sample as described in the DBNBS method (three replicates per beverage).

steps.title: Separate DBNBS reduction products by HPLC
steps.instruction: Inject 80 µl of each assay mixture into a Sunniest C18 column (5 µm, 250 × 4.6 mm) on a Waters 2095/996 HPLC system equipped with a multidiode‑array detector; equilibrate the column with 10 % CH₃CN in 0.1 % TFA containing either 10 mM ammonium acetate or 5 mM ammonia/ammonium acetate; run a linear gradient from 2 % to 50 % CH₃CN over 40 min at a flow rate of 1 ml/min using mobile phases of H₂O and CH₃CN.

substeps.instruction: Inject 80 µl of sample.
Equilibrate the C18 column with 10 % CH₃CN in 0.1 % TFA plus 10 mM ammonium acetate (or 5 mM ammonia/ammonium acetate).
Run a linear gradient from 2 % to 50 % CH₃CN over 40 minutes at 1 ml/min.
Detect eluted compounds with the multidiode‑array detector.

steps.title: Analyze eluate by electrospray MS
steps.instruction: Introduce the HPLC eluate into a Shimadzu IT‑TOF‑MS (negative mode) and set the following parameters: electrospray voltage 4.5 kV; nebulizer N₂ flow 1.5 l/min and 5 l/min; trap‑cooling Ar flow 95 ml/min; ion‑trap pressure 1.7 × 10⁻² Pa; TOF region pressure 1.5 × 10⁻⁴ Pa; ion accumulation time 30 ms; collision energy 50 %.

substeps.instruction: Select negative ion mode.
Set electrospray voltage to 4.5 kV.
Adjust nebulizer N₂ gas flow to 1.5 l/min and then to 5 l/min as required.
Set trap‑cooling Ar gas flow to 95 ml/min.
Maintain ion‑trap pressure at 1.7 × 10⁻² Pa and TOF pressure at 1.5 × 10⁻⁴ Pa.
Set ion accumulation time to 30 ms.
Set collision energy to 50 %.

steps.title: Process data and perform statistics
steps.instruction: Use Microsoft Excel 2016 to calculate mean, standard deviation and coefficient of determination for each set of triplicate measurements; then apply One‑way ANOVA with Statmate III for Windows to assess significance between datasets.

substeps.instruction: Enter triplicate results into Excel.
Calculate mean, standard deviation and R² (coefficient of determination).
Run One‑way ANOVA using Statmate III for Windows.
Interpret p‑values to determine significant differences.
